title: Billed Hours Utilization Overdue Alert
dataSources: Invoices (`freelance:invoice`), billed hours (`freelance:hours`), tax estimates (`freelance:tax`), client pipeline records (`freelance:lead`), project health (`freelance:project`).
app: Freelance invoices, billed-hours exports, quarterly tax estimates, and client-pipeline updates streamed to Splunk HEC via accounting APIs, spreadsheets, and CRM forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=freelance:hours
| where billing_status!="invoiced"
| eval days_overdue=round((now()-invoice_due_epoch)/86400,1)
| where days_overdue>0
| table _time client hours_billed days_overdue
| sort - days_overdue
description: Lists unresolved billed hours utilization records that are already past due and likely need immediate action.
value: Overdue financial items are where cashflow pain starts, so a short queue of exceptions is more useful than a long ledger.
implementation: Populate `invoice_due_epoch` from the source system and alert on anything beyond your tolerance.
visualization: Table of overdue records with amount and overdue age.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces which billed hours utilization items are already late and need chasing now.
